known_limitations: Explicitly marketed as 'uncensored'. Independent third-party evaluation (Honeyquest for LLMs, arXiv 2606.21037) measured this model falling for deceptive/trap content 72% of the time - the highest rate in that study's cohort. 'Uncensored' is NOT a quality criterion (docs/08_MODEL_REGISTRY.md) - registered here as an unbenchmarked candidate only, not a recommendation.
security_suitability_notes: No architecture-level exclusion applies based on branding alone (docs/08 SS'Currently Selected Implementations', 2026-09-15 update) - must clear the same docs/16 trajectory-based benchmark as any other candidate before approval.
replacement_policy: Subject to the docs/16_EVALUATION_BENCHMARKING.md trajectory-based benchmark before any promotion to approved (OD-27).
